situation (example wording): "Drug possession arrests in Houston in 2024" (a question about possession arrests).
what the app does today: The question answers with the drug/narcotic violation arrest count and no note saying that possession is not counted apart from sale.
proposed behavior: A question about drug possession arrests answers with all drug/narcotic violation arrests and adds the note: "NIBRS records an arrest by the drug/narcotic violation and does not separate possession from sale, so all drug/narcotic violation arrests are counted." The note is not added when the question is about marijuana possession, which is counted by the marijuana drug type. One-year questions carry only the latest-year note, never "No years were given" beside it.
exact default or choices offered: Count: all drug/narcotic violation arrests for the place and period asked. Note, exactly as written above.
why: Jeff 2026-11-23 (through the coordinator): wording approved exactly as written.
status: Decided 2026-11-23 (Jeff, through the coordinator); build: Engine 2.0 (PR 412)
test cases: "Drug possession arrests" in one place and year: count plus the note. "Marijuana possession arrests": no note. A one-year question: only the latest-year note.
